runtime_environment.timing_scope: aif_decision_total and its components exclude logging; controller_step_total includes the construction of the per-decision log record in Mode B (not the per-step raw log, which is written only for one episode per condition in seed 1 and is outside the timer)

observability.foot contact: derived from MuJoCo contact list (simulator data, not in the 17-dim observation)
observability.lateral tilt / lateral impulse: sensor incapable / not representable: Walker2d is planar
observability.push force: not measured (no force sensor is given to any controller)
